run_flop_analysis: run the analyze_model.py script with --tasks flop to count GFLOPs for a Detectron2 model
run_activation_analysis: run the analyze_model.py script with --tasks activation to count activations per operator type
run_parameter_count: run the analyze_model.py script with --tasks parameter to print the model parameter count table
run_structure_display: run the analyze_model.py script with --tasks structure to print the full model structure
run_multi_task_analysis: run the analyze_model.py script with multiple --tasks to analyze flops, activations, and parameters together
